No post-execution extension hooks are registered. The plan and design artifacts are complete — **this is the plan gate**, so please review before I generate tasks or write any code.

## 📐 Plan ready for review — `specs/001-bookmark-manager/`

**Generated artifacts:** `plan.md`, `research.md`, `data-model.md`, `contracts/api.md`, `quickstart.md`

### Proposed technical approach

| Concern | Decision |
|---|---|
| **Shape** | Single Node.js web app — Express serves REST API (`/api/*`) + the browser UI, one `npm start` on `0.0.0.0:4000` |
| **UI** | Dependency-light vanilla JS/HTML/CSS, **no build step** (views: all / unread / archive / detail-edit) |
| **Storage** | Local **SQLite** for records; files on disk for snapshots, thumbnails, favicons — all local, durable across restarts, no external service |
| **Auto details** | Headless **Chromium (Playwright)** renders the page; parse title/description/OpenGraph image/favicon |
| **Snapshot** | Web pages → single-file **MHTML** (faithful static); **PDFs stored as original PDF bytes**; thumbnail = og:image or a screenshot |
| **Duplicates** | Normalize the URL, look up across active **and** archived; on match, open existing for editing |
| **Import/export** | Standard **Netscape bookmark HTML**; folders → tags; no duplicate addresses |
| **Testing** | `node:test` (unit/contract) + **Playwright 1.61.0** pinned to the shared browser for e2e |

**Constitution check:** the project constitution is an unpopulated template (no ratified principles), so there are no governance gates to enforce — **PASS**, no violations.

### Two choices worth your explicit nod

1. **No frontend framework** (vanilla JS, no build step). Keeps the toolchain simple and reproducible for review. If you'd prefer a React/Vue-based UI, now is the moment to say so — it changes the plan and tasks.
2. **MHTML for web-page snapshots.** It's a single self-contained file browsers render faithfully as a static page — matches your "faithful static, no interactivity" call. (PDFs are kept as PDFs regardless.)

---
